# AgentData Boundary MCP

Paid remote MCP for agent data-access boundary reviews, permission scope evidence, sensitive data notes, and governance receipts.

Website: https://agentdataboundary.clauxel.com/
MCP endpoint: https://agentdataboundary.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://agentdataboundary.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Docs: https://github.com/clauxel/agent-data-boundary-mcp

Use case: Permission boundary receipts for ChatGPT agents.
Authentication: Bearer token required for production use.
Tools: map_permissions, flag_sensitive_fields, summarize_boundary, export_remediation_plan
